line.en: One isometric block of the world on a pale textbook plate, cut open as it is explained.

for.en: Anything in layers, cut open: geology, soil and groundwater, the tissues of the body, the structure of a building.
for.zh-CN: 剖开看分层的一切：地质、土壤与地下水、人体组织、建筑结构。

not.en: Processes over time; things with no inside to show.
not.zh-CN: 随时间展开的过程；没有内部可看的东西。
